Cost change, grows, accepted (D13): a var copied from an element of an inline list holds the type it has, so a tuple of accumulators encodes what was decoded, where the reference carries the element as Data. The extra decode and encode are the rule of one representation per binder, not a need: the reference agrees with the JVM without them. Value and traces agree at all four levels.
